name: Michael Gahler - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep supporting Ukraine against Russia's war and to open the next stage of Ukraine's talks to join the EU without delay. It asks for more sanctions on Russia, more money and weapons for Ukraine, and action to return deported Ukrainian children. It also asks Ukraine to keep reforming its courts, fight corruption and protect freedoms. The report is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Council to open all EU accession talks with Ukraine.
- **Who it affects:** Ukraine, EU governments, and Russians under sanctions.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide whether to act on these requests.
